notes.title: IP Cameras Input
notes.content:
- This submenu is available on some Windows platforms, for IP cameras using the ONVIF protocol for automatic discovery in a local network, and using the RTSP (Real Time Streaming Protocol) protocol for streaming.
- A recent version of the FFMPEG program must be installed and globally accessible on the system.
- PTZ (Pan-Tilt-Zoom) command support is not mandatory, but PTZ commands can be sent by the application.
- If there is no information saved or if you want to update the saved information, you must perform the following operations successively:
- Press the Discover button, to discover the cameras. This may take a few seconds.
- Fill in the username and password fields for each camera found.
- Press the Connect button, to find and display the URLs of the audio and video streams.
- Press the "Start Streams" button, to start streaming the streams.
- Press the "Stop Streams" button, to stop streaming the streams.
- When streaming, you can play the SameGame game (132 cubes, the cubes do not fall, but the edges become black).
- You can also start the visualization without game with different numbers of cubes (for example: 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 and 132 cubes).
- A video stream is assigned to each cube. If there are not enough cameras, the streams are repeated so that all cubes have a stream to display.
- After choosing a camera (element 0, game or animation), by selecting the element 10 (PTZ), you can send PTZ commands to it (directional keys, PAGE UP and PAGE DOWN).
- By selecting the element 1 (SameGame cubes), you can move or enlarge the cubes containing the video streams.
- You can use the motion detection option to only display images in case of movement.
- The theoretical maximum is set to 132 cameras.
- A demo version only allows two cameras. The word "Demo" can be displayed in the video streams.

- The "IP Cameras Input" option is compatible with existing games, by choosing a main camera. The Streams must be stopped, after being activated at least once.
- The first camera with a stream entered is chosen as the main camera. You can also choose another camera by entering and saving the "Main IP Address" field.
- During the different games offered by the application, you can choose to use the video stream of the main camera as a texture for the main cube of the game.
- By selecting the element 2 (main image), you can move or enlarge the main cube (directional keys, PAGE UP and PAGE DOWN), set it in motion or stop it (SPACE key).
- With this option, if you play an AFrame or Three game with Carousel, a maximum of video streams are taken into account.
- If you choose or force a game with the IP Camera Input, the video stream of the main camera is used as a panorama for the game.
- The VR and AR options remain available, as well as the settings "Opaque Zone Shape", "Use Color Mixing", ...
- You can thus play while monitoring the video stream of the main camera.

notes.title: Three Animations
notes.content:
With Three animations, in immersive XR mode, with one or two controllers, you can play sports at the same time as the animations.
You have to aim at the stationary machine, press the trigger of a controller and make movements with this controller.
The machine starts and stops as soon as the trigger is released.
If we want to accumulate machine travel times, we repeat the following actions:
- We press the Squeeze button on the controller.
- We make a movement.
- We release the Squeeze.
The amount of time accumulated is proportional to the movement made.
Without wanting to exercise, you can aim the machine while it is stopped, press the trigger to activate it, continue aiming and press the trigger so that it remains active.

notes.title: Punch Mode
notes.content:
Punch Mode:
- In multiplayer, the punch mode can be used for training or playing.
- It is necessary to be in fullscreen VR with one or two controllers on.
- In Game:
-If you touch a cube with a monster in texture, you earn partial points.
- If you touch a cube with a normal image in texture, you lose all your partial points.
- If the total partial points reaches a certain value, the active monster column is destroyed.
Remark:
- Update of the  Chromium version.

notes.title: Camera Input
notes.content:
Added the "Force Camera Input" button.
With this button, the camera input can provide the background panorama (planar panorama or spherical panorama). In the Settings menu you can find other setting options.

As with the 3D models, if the area containing the Roller Coaster is superimposed (special case or Roller Coaster option as 3D model), with the 3D cube mode, it can be moved in the three directions (X, Y and Z, directional keys, PAGE UP and PAGE DOWN keys).
It can also be narrowed or enlarged with Zoom mode (directional keys, PAGE UP and PAGE DOWN keys).

notes.title: A-Frame / Multiplayer
notes.content:
- Game mode without SameGame.
    - If we shoot and do not touch a column of monsters, we are penalized.
    - If we touch a column of monsters, if we are not penalized, the column falls and disappears, we get points.
	- If we touch a column of monsters, if we are penalized, the column does not fall, but we get a decrease in penalty.

- Multiplayer mode.
	- After the monsters, we face the other players, following the same rules as before.
	- One can no longer join a room (scheduled for up to 100 players and 4 hours) if a player has finished with the monsters.
	- One can not definitively kill an opponent if one has fewer points than him.
	- The winner is the one who manages to kill all the others.
    - The first who opens a Room (Room in English) chooses a number and chooses to enable or to disable the audio communications.

Demonstration A-Frame / Multiplayer:
https://games.whmsoft.net/FreeTheAnimation/home_aframe.php?multi=1&demo=1

notes.title: A-Frame / WebVR
notes.content:
The version with the virtual reality and A-Frame / WebVR is available (in test mode).
- Launch SteamVR.
- Use a default compatible web browser (https://webvr.info).
- Enable WebVR if necessary (with Chrome for example).
- Choose an "Audio Mode" to enable or disable a 3D positional audio track.
- Choose the "Game Mode" to play and kill the monsters by avoiding to miss them.
